title: Philosophy: Ethics

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA and completion of 10 credits of philosophy coursework

sections.credentialCompletionRequirements:
Completion Requirements

Minimum 50 credits

• Minimum 25 credits from approved list of ethics and justice-related courses. See department for approved course list.

• One from PHIL 115, PHIL 120, or upper-division course in logic (5 credits)

• One from PHIL 320, PHIL 330, PHIL 335, or PHIL 340. Adviser must approve substitutions (5 credits)

• One from PHIL 322, PHIL 332, PHIL 342, or 400-level course in the same areas. Adviser must approve substitutions (5 credits)

• Minimum four UW 400-level philosophy courses, excluding PHIL 484, two of which must be from approved list of ethics and justice-related courses (12-20 credits)

• Minimum 25 credits taken through UW

• Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA for all philosophy courses taken
